move: blurred colour blobs, serif letters and hairlines all sway on sines, seamless
how: Three large blurred radial blobs (blue, pink, mint, screen-blended, blur(70px)), a static SVG fractalNoise grain at 18%, a thin 560px ring, two gradient hairlines above and below, an italic serif title split into letter spans, and a spaced caption. There is no timeline: seek(t) maps t to a phase p over 2pi and sets every property as a sine of p: blobs drift 120 to 160px and breathe 8 to 12% in scale, each letter bobs y 22 / x 6 / rotate 1.5deg with a 0.55 rad phase offset per letter and opacity .86 to 1, the hairlines slide x 220 in opposite directions while scaleX breathes .55 to 1.05, the ring spins 360 per loop with a 3deg skew wobble, and the caption's letter-spacing and opacity pulse. Because every value is periodic in D, frame 0 equals frame 90 and the loop is seamless.
adapt: Change the title word (split into spans), the three blob colours, the caption and the serif face; the amplitudes (22px letter bob, 140px blob drift) can be scaled to taste. Keep everything as pure sines of the phase so it stays seamless.
port: mount(el, shot) creates blobs, grain SVG (unique filter id), ring, lines, title spans and caption; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap.timeline holding one proxy tween {p: 0 to 1, duration D, ease 'none'} whose onUpdate runs the same gsap.set calls with phase p*2pi, targets resolved once from el in mount.
caveats: three 500-700px elements with filter blur(70px) are slow to render
the fx.register seek loop must become an onUpdate proxy tween on the returned timeline
